items.name: Library Remote Access
items.description: Use OpenAthens to access library subscriptions away from campus.
steps: Open the MIT Central Library portal and choose Login, then Log in with SSO.
Select the MAHE University Microsoft Azure option.
Sign in with your @manipal.edu or @learner.manipal.edu email.

items.name: Academic Regulations - 2022 Scheme
items.description: Read the published attendance, assessment, examination, and progression rules for the 2022 curriculum scheme.
items.appliesTo: 2022 curriculum scheme only. Confirm your applicable scheme and later amendments with the Academic Section.

items.name: Academic Regulations - 2026
items.description: Read BTech attendance, assessment, promotion, backlog, graduation, honours, and branch-change rules.
items.appliesTo: Published in the MIT UG Academic Handbook 2026-2027. Confirm which regulations apply to your batch with the Academic Section; do not assume these replace the 2022 scheme.

items.name: First-Year BTech Syllabus - CS Branches (2026)
items.description: Find first- and second-semester course codes, credits, physics and chemistry cycles, topics, and references for CS branches.
items.appliesTo: Curriculum 2026; common to first-year BTech CS branches. Check your curriculum before using this syllabus for another batch.

items.name: First-Year BTech Syllabus - Core Branches (2026)
items.description: Find first- and second-semester course codes, credits, physics and chemistry cycles, topics, and references for core branches.
items.appliesTo: Curriculum 2026; common to first-year BTech core branches. This is separate from the CS syllabus; check your curriculum before using it for another batch.

items.name: Scholarships & Financial Aid
items.description: Browse the MAHE scholarship catalogue and filter by campus and institute to find the applicable policy.
items.appliesTo: Eligibility, application, and renewal conditions depend on the scholarship and intake.

items.name: Freeship, Scholar & Achiever Scholarships
items.description: Find BTech scholarship instructions, annual academic-performance criteria, and renewal conditions. Freeship and Scholar awards start in the first year; Achiever awards start from the second year.
items.appliesTo: BTech policy covering MIT Manipal and MIT Bengaluru. Confirm the scholarship and renewal conditions for your intake.

items.name: HBSF-MAHE EduEmpower Scholarship
items.description: Read the MIT Manipal BTech scholarship application, selection, continuation, and disqualification conditions.
items.appliesTo: MIT Manipal BTech students. The published page references a 2025 application form; confirm intake-specific terms with MAHE before applying.

items.name: Scholarship for Meritorious Girl Students
items.description: Find the MIT Manipal scholarship instructions for meritorious girl students, including renewal and branch-change conditions.
items.appliesTo: Limited to eligible MIT Manipal branches and intakes. The published page references a 2025 application form; confirm the applicable branch list and intake terms before applying.

items.name: Fee Refund Policy - 2026 Admissions (AICTE, Non-MBA)
items.description: Find withdrawal procedures, required documents, dues-clearance requirements, and refund rules for BTech, MTech, MCA, and other listed AICTE-approved programmes.
items.appliesTo: 2026 admissions; AICTE-approved programmes other than MBA. Published withdrawal deadlines may already have passed. Check the policy for your intake rather than assuming a current refund entitlement.

items.name: MIT Study Abroad Programme
items.description: Find semester eligibility, academic requirements, application documents, and credit transfer instructions.
steps: Check the published eligibility requirements and select a host university.
Submit the application and parent or guardian undertaking for review.
Obtain course approval and a learning agreement before arranging travel. Start at least six months ahead.
